title: ENERGUMENS
text: ENERGUMENS, in church-hitory, perfons lip- pdfet to be purified by the devil, concerning whom there were regiments among the primitive Christians. They were denied baptirn, and the eu- charifit at held, this was the practice of from students: i and thought they were under the care of exercils, yet it was thought a becoming act of charity, to let them have the public prayers of the church, in which they were permitted to be prefect. See Exgressions.
